text:
rachael: heads-up — noticed a recurring pattern in the kv-cache telemetry for the last 3 days: small models (<= 1B) show steady p50 residency but p99 residency and eviction-rate spike during long chat sessions. suspect fragmentation + page-chain thrash.

dom: can you paste the query / panels you used?

rachael: pasted below. sampling window = 60s, per-shard counters. want a sanity check on what metrics we should add.

rachael: ```sql
-- sampled from observability-prod.kv_cache
SELECT
  model,
  shard,
  hist_percentile(residency_ms, array[50,90,95,99]) AS residency_pcts,
  sum(evictions) AS evictions_60s,
  avg(fragmentation_score) AS frag_score
FROM kv_cache_samples
WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY model, shard;
```

kevin: frag_score is coarse — we need to break fragmentation into two counters: page-chain-length and stale-slot-ratio. those give different signals. page-chain-length correlates with CPU scan time during eviction.

anjali: Agree. Also add 'age-at-eviction' histogram so we can see if we're evicting very young fragments (indicates reuse-window regression).

dom: quick ask: do we have per-batch KV miss amplification? when batching grows, kv lookups per request can spike if caching isn't coalescing. could cause memory churn + async eviction.

rachael: no explicit counter today. current metrics: hits, misses, residency-percentiles, evictions total. I prototyped a 'lookup-multiplicity' gauge (avg KV lookups per user request) — it's noisy.

kevin: proposal: emit three new counters per shard/model:
- eviction_reason{manual,age,pressure,compact} (increment on eviction with label)
- page_chain_len (gauge sample distribution)
- lookup_multiplicity (histogram per request)

anjali: +1. Also add a derived metric: eviction_rate_ratio = evictions / served_tokens (normalized to baseline traffic). alerts on >2x baseline for 5m.

rachael: can we get a quick dashboard mock? panels: p50/p95/p99 residency, eviction_rate_ratio, eviction_reason stacked, page_chain_heatmap, age-at-eviction histogram, lookup_multiplicity CDF, per-model memory-growth slope over 1h windows.

dom: rough grafana panel list looks good. one more ask — add a 'reuse-window' test in loadgen: synthetic sequence where prompt prefixes repeat at intervals (1s,10s,60s,600s) to exercise spaiky long-context reuse. then plot residency tail vs reuse interval.

kevin: operational notes: when we instrument eviction_reason, attach 'kernel_path' label (fast-path, slow-path, quant-path) so we can correlate kernel selection with eviction patterns (some kernels do more aggressive prefetch/compact and change access patterns).

anjali: love that. we should also track 'batch_size_at_eviction' to check batching heuristics causing thrash. small batches + many lookups seems worst.

rachael: can someone add the metrics PR? I can sketch the dashboard panels and alert thresholds.

dom: I can pick up the metrics PR (shard-side). will add eviction_reason + page_chain_len + age_at_eviction histogram. will stub lookup_multiplicity — need a small pointer in serving to tag requests.

kevin: i'll add kernel_path label in the runtime; will also emit batch_size_at_eviction.

anjali: i'll prototype the loadgen reuse-window experiment and dashboard mock images.

sre-bot: deploy scheduled: metrics/kv-eviction-reasons - canary to prod-metrics in 30m. see: https://ci.internal/2790011111

rachael: thanks team. after canary, let's meet Friday 15:00 to review dashboard + first 24h. :thumbsup:

dom: added TODO in my queue: LINK-2347 (kv-metrics-eviction-reasons). I'll post the PR link when ready.

kevin: one more note — maybe compute a 'sweep score' per shard: weighted( page_chain_len * frag_score * eviction_rate ) so we can sort hot-shards for background compaction. we'll iterate on weights.

rachael: ok wrapped. Friday sync and we'll validate that alert baseline doesn't trigger noise.
